title: Speech production under stress for machine learning: multimodal dataset of 79 cases and 8 signals
why_promising: Primary Czech speech from 79 participants recorded in controlled stress/cognitive-load tasks; authors developed BESSTiANNO for precise segmentation and manual verification of audio/video streams and report manual checking/correction of alignment. Dataset retains synchronized multimodal streams and participant stress/task metadata.
open_question: Dataset access requires signing a license agreement before a download link is provided. Verify whether the released segmentation metadata can be obtained non-interactively, enumerate exact speech-segment annotation files/tables, and determine which boundaries/labels were human-created or human-corrected before core admission.
